fact: HISP Rwanda's project page says the KARAME app is the Ministry of Education's official mobile application for digital attendance under the Zero Out-of-School Children project, with MINEDUC as project owner and the Education Above All Foundation as primary project partner and supporter; classroom teachers record daily attendance, and the app is officially live; the page states no level of school and no count of schools, and carries no date of its own.
title: KARAME Mobile Application
